title: Appointed as Assistant
original: You can hand me whatever work you want, as long as I'm capable of handling it. After all, I'm here to let you catch your breath, Doctor.

title: Talk 1
original: My sickness isn't that bad. It hurts once in a while, but I can take it. Doctor, I'll continue working, be sure of that. I don't want to let anyone down.

title: Talk 2
original: I think… I ate them all. Eh...? Those were your snacks for the week? I'm so sorry... I can make you some cheese fondue for your afternoon teatime.

title: Talk 3
original: I still can't help but bow whenever I meet Master SilverAsh and the Saintess in the corridors, even though they tell me that at Rhodes Island, I should treat them as coworkers. I'll try, somehow.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I... wouldn't make a good explorer. I want to protect much more than explore. Driving the posts in, building a home. People as tenacious as you always need someone to watch your flanks, right? That's who I want to be, Doctor.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Master SilverAsh says that Kjerag can't forever rely on Kjeragandr, let alone another country. One day I hope to stand against the blizzard with this shield, for the sake of my family.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I have dreams of snowy mountains all the time. Dreams of... running across lakes frozen deep. But my home isn't just snow and ice. Grass covers the valleys, and trains weave swiftly between the slopes. Those, too, form the Kjerag of my memories.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: ...I'm always asleep when you come to see me? No, I'm not feeling unwell or anything. It's a habit; I work for days at a time, and the moment I lie down, I fall into a long, deep sleep. But just call my name, Doctor, and I'll wake up straight away. Don't worry about me.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, have you ever seen the aurora? When I was a student, I saw it just once in the northernmost tundra. It was very soon after I got sick, and I had to say goodbye to the survey group. If I can ever go back... would you come see the aurora with me?

title: Idle
original: Doct... you can have my jacket, okay? You'll catch a cold, sleeping somewhere like this.

title: Onboard
original: Doctor, I'm Aurora. My boss Closure talks about you a lot. I promised her I'd protect you.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Is this... a record from the battle in Lungmen? So this is another way you can use shields... I've learned a lot.

title: Promotion 1
original: Captain Sharp's assessment... is so high? And you agree as well? I... I'm so happy!

title: Promotion 2
original: Could I send this medal home? I want my mother to know, I might be sick, but not everything looks bad. I have made my way.

title: Added to Squad
original: A field mission again? I'm with you, Doctor.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You want me leading? I... I'll work to follow Captain Sharp's example.

title: Depart
original: Aurora, moving out.

title: Begin Operation
original: You there, stay back! Don't come any closer.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Doctor, give the word.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Awaiting orders.

title: Deployment 1
original: Appropriate terrain for me.

title: Deployment 2
original: Don't even think of coming through.

title: In Battle 1
original: The snows of my home... are with me.

title: In Battle 2
original: Snow, be what boils my blood.

title: In Battle 3
original: Snow, be what freezes their blood.

title: In Battle 4
original: Snow, be what warms my family.

title: 4-star Result
original: I'll become stronger than I was, to make your victories easier.

title: 3-star Result
original: Stay back, for just a second... I'm too icy now. Let me just rub a bit to warm up... good, that's better! Alright, now it's safe to high-five!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Next time, I won't let a single one escape.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, we have to retreat! Can you still move? Get on my back... no, I'll carry you!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: It's so hot in here...

title: Tap
original: M-My cookies are gonna spill!

title: Trust Tap
original: Are you heading out? I'll be your bodyguard.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, Happy New Year. I hope the snowflakes that cover the land this year can be gentler and warmer than before.

title: Greeting
original: You're looking well, Doctor. Just say if you need anything.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday! Sit here and wait for me one moment, okay? Shield output adjusted, and... Look! Now it's snowing inside your room! When the snowflakes melt in the palm of your hand, doesn't it feel so wonderful? I've always been wanting another chance to see the snows of Kjerag with you!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island has alleviated my Oripathy, and given me a great job, so by all rights, I shouldn't be asking for anything more... but, Doctor! If you'd be willing to take a look at this proposal for improving the dormitory refrigeration and air conditioning, I'd be very, very thankful! You—You accepted it? Really?!
